mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_bom ( product_id, material_id, quantity, max_attrition_ratio, product_fluctuation, create_time ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{materialId}, #{quantity}, #{maxAttritionRatio}, #{productFluctuation}, #{createTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_bom SET product_id = #{productId}, material_id = #{materialId}, quantity = #{quantity}, max_attrition_ratio = #{maxAttritionRatio}, product_fluctuation = #{productFluctuation} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT pb.id, pb.product_id, pb.material_id, m.name AS material_name, m.unit AS material_unit, pb.quantity, pb.max_attrition_ratio, pb.product_fluctuation FROM product_bom pb LEFT JOIN product_material m ON pb.material_id = m.id WHERE pb.product_id = #{pid}
